limits: macOS native Carbon handoff reached the IAM account and organization picker; its four directory-scope consent selections remain pending user confirmation, so that complete browser-to-native login has not been verified.
Physical hardware checks cover one Apple Silicon Mac, Pixel 8, iPhone 13 mini and iPad Air 13-inch (M4). Intel Mac, Windows and Linux installer checks do not establish physical audio behavior.
macOS Developer ID signatures are verified; notarization was not performed.
iOS installs use development provisioning for the two registered devices; this is not App Store distribution.
Final-build cold APNs was repeated on iPad only. Bluetooth, cellular interruption and network-loss recovery were not exercised.
privacy: No credentials, push tokens, device serials, private profiles or recorded audio are included in this aggregate.
